coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted queries produced usable search coverage. No independently verified new qualifying U.S. food-access interruption was identified with evidence of an event or announcement after the prior verified completion. Retrieved results were chiefly historical, general resource/program updates, grocery reopenings, or prior-year SNAP shutdown reports.

excluded_examples.reason: Historical grocery loss and newer opening, not a new disruption.
Earlier recovery/resources update, not a new cancellation in this window.
2025 shutdown notice, not a 2026 benefit interruption.

excluded_examples.publisher: Center on Budget and Policy Priorities
excluded_examples.reason: Old program-trend tracker without a new immediate interruption during the bounded window.

duplicate_screen.method: Read previous committed heartbeat directly from ops/watch-ledger and compared source event dates and recurring reported incidents.

coverage_notes.limitations: A bounded indexed search cannot exclude unindexed or late-posted hyperlocal notices; 1-2 day recency filters may return older source articles. No inference of a fresh event was made from crawl dates.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, scheduling changes, disabling, or production collector mutations.
